product: Base environments are now supported on classic compute (Beta)
tagline: You can now use base environments to manage Python dependencies on classic compute.
what_it_does: You can now use base environments to manage Python dependencies on classic compute. You can use Databricks provided environments or custom workspace level environments. Beta This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: And because Databricks caches base environments, dependencies don't resolve and install at startup, so compute starts faster and avoids failures from package resolution, repository availability, or network reliability.
